text: dsh-image-tiler 是面向 DSH 的图片处理插件：它替换本地附件存储的消息准入环节，在用户消息进入会话记录前处理内联图片。遇到模型可能缩小的大图时，插件依据图片尺寸规划相邻切片，用 sharp 裁切并编码为 PNG，再将切片作为多个图片部分提交，使模型能分别读取各区域细节。它按消息图片数量和存储上限分配切片预算；小图、预算不足、细条布局或超限时保留原图。适合需要模型辨认大截图或文档小字的场景。代码未声明插件自有密钥或外部服务；运行需要 sharp。

dsh-image-tiler splits oversized inline images into PNG regions before DSH stores a user message. Each crop is submitted separately so models can read fine detail. Unsuitable or over-limit tiles fall back to the original image. No key or external service is declared; sharp is needed at runtime.
想让模型看清大截图里的小字，而不是只收到缩小后的整张图。
能不能把上传的超大图片切成几块，再交给 DSH 识别？
Help the model read small text in a large screenshot by splitting it into image regions.
dsh-image-tiler 的「大图分区提交」功能：在用户消息准入时为内联图片规划区域，使用 sharp 裁成 PNG 图片块，并将这些块作为同一消息的图片部分交给附件存储。
dsh-image-tiler 的「保留原图回退」功能：当切片布局不合适、裁切失败或切片超出附件存储限制时，插件记录提示并改为提交原始图片内容。

dsh-image-tiler README · dsh-image-tiler：> Upload a screenshot, a photographed document, or a long comic page and the model reads the small
> text in it. Without this plugin it does not: one request image carries at most 1024 vision tokens,
> so the harness rescales anything larger before the model sees it, and an 8000x8000 screenshot
> arrives as a ~1300px-wide picture with the text already gone.
>
> This is **not** an official DeepSeek product and does not imply DeepSeek endorsement.

dsh-image-tiler README · What it does：The plugin replaces the attachment store's admission step. When a prompt carries an image too large
to survive the harness' own downscaling, it cuts the image into adjacent regions and submits each
region as its own image, in the same message. Every region is then transmitted at its own
resolution, so the model sees the source at the resolution it was uploaded at instead of at the
resolution one image can hold.

dsh-image-tiler README · What it does：Measured on a real boot (DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, desktop host, an 8000x8000 PNG of small text):

| | as one image | tiled (default settings) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| what the model receives | 2048x2048, re-encoded | 20 regions of 2000x1600, one per image part |
| glyph height in the image | 10 px in the source, unreadable after scaling | 10 px, unchanged |
| text rows the model can resolve | 0 | 8 |
| contrast in the text band | 11.2 | 29.7 |

dsh-image-tiler README · What it does：Small images are not touched, and neither are images the provider would only trim a little: the
plugin cuts a picture up only when the print it replaces would have been about seventy percent of the
source's own size or less. An ordinary 1920x1080 screenshot is printed at 1708x960 — eleven percent
narrower, which no one can see — so it stays whole and leaves the message's image budget to pictures
that need it.

dsh-image-tiler README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0` (declared in `engines.dsh`, and as `peerDependencies` on
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment` / `-attachment-local`; verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`). The range
  covers the whole `0.2.x` line, prereleases included, so a harness patch or rc bump does not
  disable the plugin.
- Node.js 20 or newer (the host's own requirement).
- Status: **experimental**. The tiling policy is verified, but the plugin replaces a core service,
  so treat a version bump of the harness as a reason to re-check it.
- `sharp` is bundled as a dependency. The plugin ships no prebuilt binaries of its own; pnpm
  installs `sharp`'s platform package for your machine as usual.

dsh-image-tiler README · From npm (recommended)：Two different versions matter here, and mixing them up is the usual mistake. Pin the **plugin** version
(`@0.1.7`): that is what keeps the install reproducible. Do **not** pin the harness: this package
accepts any harness `0.2.x`, prereleases included, so a harness patch or rc bump does not disable it.
A harness the plugin cannot work with is refused before pnpm runs —
`dsh: installation rejected: Plugin <name>@<version> is incompatible with dsh <version>` — and
`dsh plugin allow-version` exists to override that by hand if you are testing an unreleased harness.

dsh-image-tiler README · Verify the install：Send an image the provider would have printed at about two thirds of its size — a 2560x1440
screenshot, a 4K capture, an 8000x8000 page — and watch the host log:

```
image-tiler: 8000x8000 shown as 20 tiles of up to 2000x1600 (20.4x detail, 54% covered)
```

The number of image attachments in the message is what changed: one upload becomes N parts.

dsh-image-tiler README · Update / Uninstall：```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-tiler@0.1.7
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-image-tiler
```

official `attachment-local` row already accepts:

```yaml
- id: attachment-local
  disabled: true          # the plugin serves `attachments` in its place

dsh-image-tiler README · Configuration：Every key of the official `attachment-local` row still applies, unchanged: `dshHome`,
`maxImageBytes`, `maxImagesPerMessage`, `maxMessageImageBytes`, `maxImagePixels`,
`maxImageDimension`, `normalizedImageMaxPixels`, `normalizedImageMaxDimension`,
`normalizedImageMaxBytes`, `imageCompressionConcurrency`.

Two of them decide what the tiler can do:

dsh-image-tiler README · Configuration：| key | default | effect on tiling |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxImagesPerMessage` | `20` | The tiling budget, shared evenly by the images in one message. A single 8000x8000 upload is spent as 20 tiles of 2000x1600 (20.4x the detail of the single downscaled image); three uploads in one message get 6 tiles each (about 15.5x) so no image is left behind at the provider's print. Lowering it makes each piece larger and *less* readable, because a piece bigger than `normalizedImageMaxPixels` is downscaled after the crop. |
| `normalizedImageMaxPixels` | `4194304` | The ceiling on one published image. The planner is told this number and keeps every piece under it, so no piece is downscaled after being cut. |
| `maxImageBytes` | `20971520` | The ceiling on one stored image. A tile bigger than this would make the store refuse the whole message, so the tiler measures every tile and sends the source whole if one of them is over. In practice a piece lands far below it: PNG is lossless, so even photographic tiles stay in single-digit megabytes. |

dsh-image-tiler README · Configuration：The row also has to be reachable: if the profile already raises the global image ceiling for huge
uploads, keep those values. The plugin does not change them, and a source the store refuses never
reaches the tiler.

dsh-image-tiler README · Security posture：- No telemetry, no network access, no credentials handling, no background service.
- No `prepare`, `install`, or `postinstall` scripts; the package contains JavaScript, YAML, and text.
- No child processes. Nothing is spawned or executed; `sharp` runs in-process through its native
  binding.
- Images are decoded and re-encoded in memory. Tiles are written by the harness' own attachment
  store, to the same place the original image would have gone, and nothing is written anywhere else.
- The only files the plugin reads are the ones the store hands it.

dsh-image-tiler README · How it works：1. `apply(ctx, config)` mounts `TilingAttachmentStore` under the `attachments` service name, so it
   replaces the official `attachment-local` store while extending it. Storage, admission limits,
   normalization, and reads all stay the base implementation's.
2. `admitPromptContent(content)` is the single call the session controller makes before it appends a
   user message. The override plans a tile layout for each image part, crops the source with
   `sharp`, and returns the tiles as image parts.
3. Because the replacement happens before admission, the tiled images become part of the stored
   session message itself. Replay, resume, and fork rebuild exactly what the model originally saw.
4. The layout comes from `lib/geometry.js`, which transcribes the provider's own image projection
   (patch/downsample grid, 1024-token budget) and picks the grid whose regions land closest to 1:1
   with what the provider would otherwise have sent. A layout has to buy back at least twice the
   detail per source pixel before it is worth the image parts it spends, so a source the provider
   would print at nearly its own size yields exactly one tile.

dsh-image-tiler README · Development：```
node test/geometry.test.mjs        # tile geometry invariants, no test runner needed
node test/admission.test.mjs       # prompt admission: budgets, fallbacks, part order
node test/_cap-table.mjs           # layout table for each tile cap

dsh-image-tiler README · Known limitations：- **A tiled upload costs more vision tokens than a single image.** Cutting one source into N pieces
  sends N images; that is the point, but a 20-tile upload is a much larger request than a 1-image
  upload.
- **Tile size is capped by the store's normalization policy.** A tile larger than
  `normalizedImageMaxPixels` (4194304, i.e. about 2048x2048) is downscaled after the crop, which is
  why the planner fills the whole `maxImagesPerMessage` budget (20 by default) instead of using a
  few big pieces.
- **The piece count follows `maxImagesPerMessage`, so a lower value gives worse tiles.** With the
  budget lowered to 6, an 8000x8000 source becomes five 4579x915 strips: complete and clear, but not
  the shape a reader would pick. The default of `20` produces the squarest layout.
- **Several large uploads in one message share the budget.** Ten images at once leave two pieces
  each, below the four a layout needs to divide a source rather than shave it, so they are sent at
  the provider's print. Send large images one or two at a time when their detail matters.

> 上传截图、拍下来的文档、长漫画页，模型就能看清里面的小字 —— 没有这个插件它看不清：一张请求图片
> 最多只能承载 1024 个视觉 token，所以 Harness 会先把更大的图缩掉，8000x8000 的截图到了模型眼里
> 只剩下约 1300 像素宽，字已经没了。
>
> 本项目**不是** DeepSeek 官方产品，也不代表 DeepSeek 的认可。

dsh-image-tiler README · 它做什么：插件替换了附件存储的「准入」环节。当一条消息里的图片大到无法在 Harness 自己的缩放中存活时，插件把
这张图切成相邻的若干区域，并在同一轮消息里把每个区域当作一张独立图片提交。每个区域于是按自己的
分辨率发送，模型看到的就是上传时的分辨率，而不是单张图片能装下的分辨率。

真机实测（DSH 0.2.0-rc.2、桌面宿主、一张写满小字的 8000x8000 PNG）：

| | 单张图片 | 切片（默认配置） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 模型实际收到 | 2048x2048，被重新编码 | 20 个 2000x1600 区域，各占一个图片 part |
| 字形高度 | 源图 10 px，缩放后不可读 | 仍是 10 px |
| 能分辨的文字行 | 0 行 | 8 行 |
| 文字带对比度 | 11.2 | 29.7 |

dsh-image-tiler README · 它做什么：小图不受影响，只被轻微缩小的图也不受影响：只有当 provider 会把这张图压到原尺寸的七成以下时，插件才会
切。1920x1080 的普通截图在 provider 那里会被打成 1708x960 —— 窄了一成一，人眼根本看不出来 —— 所以
它保持整张，把一条消息的图片配额留给真正需要的图。

dsh-image-tiler README · 兼容性：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0`（写在 `engines.dsh` 里，同时以 `peerDependencies` 声明在
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment` / `-attachment-local` 上；已在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测）。这个范围覆盖
  整个 `0.2.x`（含预发布版），所以宿主的小版本或 rc 变化不会让插件被停用。
- Node.js 20 或更高（宿主自身的要求）。
- 状态：**实验性**。切片策略经过真机验证，但插件替换的是核心服务，宿主大版本变化后建议重新验证。
- `sharp` 是运行时依赖。插件不自带预编译二进制，pnpm 会照常为你的机器安装 `sharp` 的平台包。

dsh-image-tiler README · 从 npm 安装（推荐）：```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-tiler@0.1.7
```

这里有两个版本号，混淆它们是常见错误。要固定的是**插件**版本（`@0.1.7`），它才决定安装可复现；
**不要**去固定宿主版本——本包接受任何 `0.2.x`（含预发布版），宿主的小版本或 rc 变化不会让插件失效。
宿主实在不兼容时，安装器会在 pnpm 运行之前就拒绝：
`dsh: installation rejected: Plugin <name>@<version> is incompatible with dsh <version>`；
如果你在测试未发布的宿主，可以用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 手动放行。

dsh-image-tiler README · 验证安装：发一张 provider 会打成原尺寸三分之二的图片 —— 2560x1440 的截图、4K 截图、8000x8000 的长页 ——
然后看宿主日志：

```
image-tiler: 8000x8000 shown as 20 tiles of up to 2000x1600 (20.4x detail, 54% covered)
```

变化体现在消息里的图片附件数量上：一次上传变成了 N 个 part。

dsh-image-tiler README · 更新 / 卸载：```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-tiler@0.1.7
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-image-tiler
```

dsh-image-tiler README · 配置：插件本身不新增任何配置项。它就是那个存储，所以它读的只有官方 `attachment-local` 行本来就接受的
那一个 `config:` 块：

```yaml
- id: attachment-local
  disabled: true          # 由插件顶替它来提供 `attachments`

- insert:

官方 `attachment-local` 行的全部配置项照旧生效：`dshHome`、`maxImageBytes`、`maxImagesPerMessage`、
`maxMessageImageBytes`、`maxImagePixels`、`maxImageDimension`、`normalizedImageMaxPixels`、
`normalizedImageMaxDimension`、`normalizedImageMaxBytes`、`imageCompressionConcurrency`。

其中两项决定切片行为：

dsh-image-tiler README · 配置：| 配置项 | 默认值 | 对切片的影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxImagesPerMessage` | `20` | 切片预算，由同一条消息里的图片**平均分摊**。单张 8000x8000 上传会被花成 20 块 2000x1600（相对单张缩图有 20.4 倍细节）；同一条消息里发三张则每张 6 块（约 15.5 倍），这样没有哪张图被落在 provider 的打印尺寸上。调小会让每块变大、**更不清晰**：大于 `normalizedImageMaxPixels` 的块会在裁剪之后被缩小。 |
| `normalizedImageMaxPixels` | `4194304` | 单张发布图的上限。规划器会读到这个数字并保证每块都不超过它，因此没有哪一块会在切完之后被缩小。 |
| `maxImageBytes` | `20971520` | 单张存储图的上限。超过它的块会让存储拒绝**整条消息**，所以插件会实测每一块的字节数，任何一块超标就改发原图。实际上块远低于这个数：PNG 是无损的，连照片类切片也只有个位数 MB。 |

dsh-image-tiler README · 配置：同时该行必须能被解析到：如果 profile 里已经为了超大图抬高过全局上限，请保留那些值 —— 插件不会改动
它们，而被存储拒收的图永远到不了切片器。

dsh-image-tiler README · 安全声明：- 无遥测、无网络访问、无凭据处理、无后台服务。
- 无 `prepare` / `install` / `postinstall` 脚本；包内只有 JavaScript、YAML 与文本。
- 不启动子进程，不执行任何外部程序；`sharp` 通过其原生绑定在进程内运行。
- 图片在内存中解码与重新编码。切片由 Harness 自己的附件存储落盘，位置与原图本来会落盘的位置相同，
  不额外写任何地方。
- 插件只读取存储交给它的那些文件。

dsh-image-tiler README · 工作原理：1. `apply(ctx, config)` 把 `TilingAttachmentStore` 挂到 `attachments` 服务名下，从而顶替官方
   `attachment-local` 存储，同时继承它。存储、准入上限、归一化、读取全部沿用基类实现。
2. `admitPromptContent(content)` 是会话控制器在追加用户消息之前唯一会调用的入口。重写它即规划切片
   布局、用 `sharp` 裁出区域，并把切片作为图片 part 返回。消息里有几张图，`maxImagesPerMessage`
   的预算就由它们平均分摊，每张的块数低于四块时整条消息都不切。
3. 因为替换发生在准入之前，切片图会成为会话消息本身的一部分：回放、恢复、分叉重建出的就是模型当时
   看到的内容。
4. 布局来自 `lib/geometry.js`，它转写了 provider 自己的图片投影（patch/downsample 网格、
   1024 token 预算），并在候选中挑出「各区域与 provider 本来会发送的图最接近 1:1」的那套网格。
   一套布局必须换回至少两倍于整张打印的像素密度，才值得占用那些图片 part，所以 provider 会按原尺寸
   附近打印的源图只会得到一块。
5. 整批切片在准入前会按存储自己的上限校验 —— 块数、每一块的存储字节数、以及总字节数。若不满足，
   或任何一块会变成细条，就改发原图并记录原因 —— 一个切坏了的插件绝不能把用户的图片弄丢，而存储
   会因为其中一个成员超标而拒绝整条消息。

dsh-image-tiler README · 开发与验证：```
node test/geometry.test.mjs        # 切片几何不变量，无需测试框架
node test/admission.test.mjs       # 消息准入：预算、退路、part 顺序
node test/_cap-table.mjs           # 各图片预算下的布局表
node test/feasibility.mjs          # 在生成的样张上做可读性量测

`test/` 不包含在发布包里。

dsh-image-tiler README · 已知限制：- **切片上传比单图消耗更多视觉 token。** 一张源图切成 N 块就是 N 张图，这正是目的，但 20 块的请求量
  远大于 1 张图。
- **切片尺寸受存储归一化策略限制。** 大于 `normalizedImageMaxPixels`（4194304，约 2048x2048）的块会在
  裁剪**之后**被缩小，所以规划器会把 `maxImagesPerMessage` 的预算（默认 20）用满，而不是只切几块大的。
- **块数跟着 `maxImagesPerMessage` 走，调低只会让切片更差。** 把预算设成 6 时，8000x8000 会变成五条
  4579x915 的横条：完整、清晰，但不是人会选的形状。默认的 `20` 给出的布局最接近方形。
- **一条消息里的多张大图要分摊预算。** 一次发十张时每张只剩两块，低于「把一张图切成网格」所需的
  四块，于是它们按 provider 的打印尺寸原样发送。细节重要时请一次发一到两张。
- **切片是不重叠的整块。** 正好压在切缝上的字会被切成两半，相邻两块都不会完整显示它。
- **只处理内联图片路径。** 以文档附件形式提交的文件、以及经由其他工具进入的图片不在处理范围内。
- 实测环境为 Windows + `0.2.0-rc.2`，其他平台未验证。
